annotation.title_clean: Buku Putih AI Nasional Disempurnakan, Tekankan Interoperabilitas dan Keberlanjutan
annotation.title_en: National AI White Paper Refined, Emphasising Interoperability and Sustainability
annotation.summary_en: Government news item reporting that Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Digital is finalising a National AI Roadmap White Paper, which will underpin two draft Presidential Regulations on the AI roadmap and AI ethics. Experts urge digital sovereignty, Green AI infrastructure, national standards and interoperability; completion targeted for end of 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: White Paper will be the basis for two draft Presidential Regulations on AI roadmap and AI ethics
Speaker argues ethics-only vision is too normative; proposes AI as primary utility and Green AI Infrastructure
National standards and interoperability protocols should precede adopting global technologies
State intervention needed to avoid AI benefiting mainly foreign corporations
White Paper targeted for completion by end of 2025
